Setup: Fully Remote
Level: Mid-Level
Industry: Software SAAS Company
Shift: US Hours
Start Date: can start in 2 weeks after offer
Equipment: Available upon request
Rate: R$8,000 - R$10,000
About The Methodical Group
The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.
About the Opportunity
Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.
The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.
Responsibilities
Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.
Qualifications
At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Sr. compliance onboarding specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. compliance onboarding specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About the Role
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.
You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.
Key Responsibilities

Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2 B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.
What We’re Looking For

Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;

Autonomia e disciplina para atuar e render bem em um ambiente 100% remoto (Home Office);
Perfil proativo e curioso com vontade real de aprender, se desenvolver profissionalmente e trazer novas ideias para a equipe.
Requisitos :
Familiaridade como usuário e criador nas principais plataformas (Instagram, Facebook, Linked In, You Tube, Tik Tok e Telegram);
Dispor de um ambiente tranquilo para trabalhar, com internet estável, smartphone e um computador com bom processamento, equipado com webcam, mouse e teclado;
Vídeo de apresentação devidamente enviado (instruções abaixo).
Diferenciais (não obrigatório) : Conhecimento prático em Canva para o auxílio na produção de peças visuais rápidas (stories, carrosséis, etc.); Familiaridade com o uso de IAs generativas ( Chat GPT, Gemini , etc.) para auxiliar em pesquisas, ideias e otimização de rotinas; Experiência básica com Notion para acompanhamento de tarefas; Conhecimento básico em Word Press (focado na postagem e formatação de artigos); Domínio do idioma inglês e/ou alemão .
Preferencialmente, deve estar cursando :
Marketing;
Jornalismo;
Relações Internacionais;
Administração de Empresas;
Publicidade e Propaganda;
Relações Públicas;
Comunicação Social;
Gestão Comercial;
Comércio Exterior;
Design Gráfico.
Sobre a empresa: A Sprache& Wissen (S& W) é uma edtech brasileira, fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-inglês. A S& W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina. No inglês, destaca-se com metodologia inovadora de aprendizagem acelerada e índice de 98,9% de satisfação. A empresa irá capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês, possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e tem valor de mercado superior a 30 milhões de reais.
Etapas do processo:

Entrevista 1;
Entrevista 2;
Aprovação.
Inicio: maio/2026
Instruções para o Vídeo de Apresentação e Envio
Como a comunicação é fundamental para essa vaga, queremos te conhecer além do currículo! Grave um vídeo rápido seguindo as orientações abaixo:

Dica: Não se preocupe com edições complexas ou superprodução. Seja autêntico(a), demonstre sua energia e certifique-se apenas de que o áudio esteja claro e o ambiente bem iluminado.

title: Investment banking intern
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Investment banking intern em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program
Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.
We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.
Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.
What You'll Gain: Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including: 3-Statement Financial Modeling
Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
Trading Comparables (Comps)
Precedent Transactions
Advanced Excel & Power Point techniques
Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development
Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
Financial Modeling
Sourcing & Due Diligence
Industry and Company Research
And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.
This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.
Who We're Looking For:
This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.
How to Apply:
Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.
This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Cloud operations engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud operations engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Eightpoint
Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U. S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.
About the Role
The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the Dev Ops team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the Dev Ops and Systems Administration teams.
Key Responsibilities

Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, Cloud Front, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
Support GCP workloads, primarily Big Query pipelines and related data infrastructure.
Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; Cloud Watch; One Uptime).
Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.
Who You Are

5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, Dev Ops, or infrastructure support role.

title: Assistente de contabilidade i grupo indiana
description:

Buscamos uma pessoa com alto desempenho, disposição para proporcionar a melhor experiência aos nossos clientes, para juntos alcançarmos objetivos.
Você atuará com atendimento a clientes internos e externos, a sua principal responsabilidade será a realização de controles e rotinas pertinentes à Contabilidade. Os principais diferenciais nesta função são a disciplina, a paciência, a atenção, o controle, a organização, a comunicação eficaz e o excelente atendimento aos clientes.
Se você é uma pessoa bem articulada, apaixonada por qualidade e gosta de desafios, aqui é o seu lugar!

Efetuar conciliações contábeis, garantindo a consistência entre saldos contábeis e financeiros.
Elaborar e acompanhar relatórios gerenciais, apoiando a análise de resultados e a tomada de decisão.
Apurar impostos federais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais dentro dos prazos legais.
Preparar e transmitir as obrigações acessórias, com foco no SPED ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital) e SPED ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal).
Apoiar o fechamento contábil mensal, assegurando conformidade com a legislação vigente e normas contábeis.

Conhecimento em rotinas fiscais, impostos e obrigações acessórias.
Excel básico/intermediário.
Organização, atenção aos detalhes e responsabilidade com prazos.
Boa comunicação, trabalho em equipe e proatividade.

﻿Somos o Grupo Indiana , um grupo genuinamente baiano que tem na satisfação dos seus clientes a sua marca registrada!

Acreditamos em um mundo de múltiplas experiências com pessoas com diferentes histórias onde os seus talentos se unem para conquistar grandes resultados. Somos o Grupo mais premiado do setor, com mais de 120 conquistas entre as principais montadoras!

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Artificial intelligence engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Job Title: AI Engineer
Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: Long Term
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: PST
Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Overview
We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI, focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.
The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics, while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering "golden paths."
Key Responsibilities
Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.
Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics, driving improvements across engineering workflows.
Build reusable patterns for:
AI-assisted code generation
Pull request automation
Test generation
Debugging workflows
Developer self-service enablement
Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools, providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.
Manage AI usage governance, including:
Token budgeting and cost controls
Usage monitoring and reporting
PII redaction guardrails
Audit logging and responsible AI practices
Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines, APIs, and AI integrations.
Integrate AI tooling into Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms.
Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications
8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience, or related engineering roles.
Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings.
Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/Saa S tools, including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.
Practical daily usage of tools such as Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT, or similar.
Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
Strong AWS experience, ideally including:
Bedrock
API Gateway
Managed AI/Cloud Services
Experience with Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab preferred).
Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Preferred / Nice to Have
Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence.
Hands-on experience with:
LLM Agents
RAG pipelines
Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.)
Lang Chain / Llama Index
Exposure to AI Fin Ops, usage reporting, and cost attribution models.
Knowledge of AI governance and security, including:
OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
Prompt injection risks
Model supply chain security
Responsible AI controls
Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

description:

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)
Contract Duration: 12+ months with extensions
Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)
Work Hours: EST
Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)
Overview
We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineer to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a "boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers to ship code efficiently and reliably.
You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement.
What You'll Do
Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)
Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting
Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable)
Maintain and improve self-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths"
Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality
Assist with service instrumentation across logging, metrics, and tracing
Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs
Participate in on-call rotation and support incident response
Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and reliability
Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash) Must-Have Requirements
6+ years in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles
Strong AWS experience (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.)
Deep Kubernetes expertise:
Operating and maintaining clusters
Experience building Kubernetes environments
Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
Python scripting (mandatory) for automation and tooling
Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
Strong Linux fundamentals
Solid understanding of observability concepts (metrics, logs, tracing) Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Git Lab CI
Exposure to Open Telemetry
API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)
Experience supporting large engineering teams (100+ developers)
Familiarity with security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows
Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)
Background in mid-size, modern engineering organizations What We're NOT Looking For
No Kubernetes experience
Bash-only engineers (no Python)
Pure consulting/advisory profiles
Pure security-focused candidates
Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds
ML/Data Science profiles Team Structure
1 Principal Engineer
1 Senior Engineer
1 Engineer (India)
You = 4th key team member

title: Graphic designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Graphic designer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Graphic Designer
Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.
You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.
What you’ll do
You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
Edit video for social distribution and website use
Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.
What matters in this role
You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
You understand how design actually shows up in B2 B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks
Requirements
4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
Video editing experience for social and web content
Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite
Context for the work
Our client sells to B2 B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:
Driving registrations and product demos
Increasing engagement
Supporting sales follow-up
Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.
What this is not
Not a pure brand exploration role
Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
Not isolated design work handed over a wall
You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.
If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

title: Analista de departamento pessoal - salvador/ba
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de departamento pessoal - salvador/ba em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.
Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador. 
Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.
SOBRE A VAGA
A Gurilândia e Land School são escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação e a Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares - Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Há 60 anos estamos educando gerações em Salvador, e preparando os nossos alunos para os desafios de hoje com uma educação que alia vanguarda e tradição.
Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de agentes de transformação que sejam capazes de alcançar realização pessoal e profissional com ética e responsabilidade social. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos, que superam desafios diariamente com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.Se você se identifica com essa missão e quer fazer parte do time, não deixe de se candidatar!
Neste papel você será responsável por processar atividades rotineiras de departamento pessoal, realizar gestão de benefícios e atendimento de colaboradores das unidades de Salvador (4 escolas). 
RESPONSABILIDADES
O que você fará:
Rotinas de DP: Admissões;
Demissões;
Gestão de jornada (controle de ponto eletrônico e manual);
Controle de férias;
Folha de Pagamento. Gestão de Benefícios (plano de saúde, plano odontológico, vale transporte, vale refeição/alimentação): Inclusão;
Exclusão;
Alteração. Conferência de NFs para pagamento: Controle e envio de pagamentos de RPA (Autônomos);
Atendimento aos colaboradores (presencial e online). Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.
REQUISITOS
O que você precisa ter: Graduação em andamento ou completa em Administração, Gestão de Recursos Humanos, Contabilidade ou áreas afins;
Excel intermediário ou avançado (procv, tabela dinâmica);
Experiência mínima de 02 anos em Departamento Pessoal. Será um diferencial se você tiver:  Experiência com BPO (folha terceirizada - Sistema Totvs RM Labore);
Inglês intermediário. Você vai se encaixar bem se conseguir: Ser organizado(a) para realizar acompanhamento e gestão das suas atividades;
Ter bom relacionamento e jogo de cintura para ter contato com pessoas de diferentes níveis de senioridade/hierárquicos.
DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA
O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.
Visit our careers site for more information;

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Recrutador em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. JOB DESCRIPTION
Aqui na Construtora Tenda , nosso propósito é claro: desafiar o impossível para que mais pessoas conquistem o seu lugar no mundo . Com 56 anos de história, somos uma empresa de capital aberto, presente em 9 estados, com mais de 5 mil colaboradores construindo o inimaginável todos os dias . Estamos entre as principais construtoras do Brasil no segmento de habitação econômica, atuando com programa Minha Casa Minha Vida, trazendo inovação, eficiência e foco em moradia digna e acessível.
Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado constante, o protagonismo e as relações simples e verdadeiras . Trabalhar na Tenda é viver desafios reais, com impacto direto na vida de milhares de famílias e também na sua própria trajetória.

Atender gestores internos para entendimento da necessidade da vaga aberta a ser trabalhada, recrutando candidatos (internos ou externos) para preenchimento da vaga;
Conduzir reunião de alinhamento de perfil da vaga com gestor e business partner para entendimento do contexto da área, garantindo assertividade na apresentação dos candidatos alinhados, garantindo cumprimento dos pré-requisitos pela descrição de cargo;
Planejar a estratégia de captação de candidatos, bem como filtros adequados para assegurar que os candidatos estejam alinhados ao perfil. Buscar e desenvolver parcerias para anunciar as vagas, com o objetivo de ampliar a captação de candidatos qualificados para o perfil das vagas;
Contribuir no aprimoramento dos roteiros de entrevistas, bem como pareceres e aplicação de dinâmicas de grupo.
Conduzir Dinâmicas de Grupo, Entrevistas e aplicação de casos de negócio/ testes, avaliando o perfil dos candidatos versus as competências exigidas para a vaga;
Acompanhar e garantir os indicadores de tempo e qualidade dos processo de sua atuação, gerando possíveis processo de acompanhamento e melhoria continua e eficiência do processo;
Acompanhar e executar projetos pontuais relacionados ao processo de Atração e seleção, para contribuir com o planejamento/crescimento do negócio;

Contribuir com as soluções de melhorias nos processos e sistemas, alinhando as necessidades de eficiência do processo bem como atendimento do negócio;

title: Senior data engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior data engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior Data Engineer
We are looking for a Senior Developer Data Engineer to build and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that enable Digital and Customer Experience Applications across a global FMCG enterprise. You will work hands on with Python, Py Spark, Databricks and SQL contribute to modern engineering practices using Gitbased workflows and CI/CD to support end to end delivery through Azure Dev Ops.
Responsibilities
Design, develop and optimize ETL ELT pipelines using Databricks, Py Spark to ingest, transform and serve data for digital customer experience.
Build and maintain highquality performant SQL transformations and dimensional curated data layers for analytics and downstream consumption.
Implement best practices for Databricks engineering notebooks vs repos modular code cluster job configuration, performance tuning and cost awareness.
Use Python for data processing utilities validations orchestration helpers and reusable libraries.
Manage source control using Git with enterprise workflows across Git Hub Bitbucket enforce PR reviews branching strategies and coding standards.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure Dev Ops automating testing packaging and deployment of data code artifacts across environments.
Ensure data quality and reliability through validations reconciliation, checks monitoring and operational runbooks.
Collaborate with product app teams analysts and platform teams to translate requirements into scalable data products aligned to customer experience journeys.
For Senior Developer lead module level design, mentor engineers drive standards for CI/CD and code quality and own delivery for critical pipelines.
Requirements
Strong handson experience with: Python, Py Spark, Databricks, jobs workflows, clusters repos, SQL advanced querying optimization.
Strong experience with Git and repository platforms, Git Hub and/or Bitbucket.
Hands on experience implementing CI/CD for data engineering workloads.
Strong working experience with Azure Dev Ops, Boards Repos Pipelines, build release workflows.
English for reading, writing and verbal communication directly with foreigners.
If this sounds like the next challenge for you, apply now with an updated resume in English and we'll take it from here :)

title: Fx trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fx trader em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.

Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Analista de processos - pcm
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de processos - pcm em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:
Realizar análises de falhas e causas raiz em equipamentos e processos.
Acompanhar e revisar indicadores de desempenho (ex: MTBF, MTTR, disponibilidade, backlog).

Apoiar a revisão de criticidade de equipamentos e matriz de risco.
Garantir a acuracidade das informações inseridas no sistema ERP.
Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios gerenciais da manutenção.

Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.
Requisitos:
Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Tecnologia em Manutenção, Produção ou áreas correlatas.
Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
Experiência em manutenção industrial.
Domínio em Análise de falhas.
Domínio em Indicadores de manutenção (MTBF, MTTR, disponibilidade).
Conhecimento Excel, Power BI e ferramentas de análise de dados.
Conhecimento Sistema ERP (Ex.: SAP), módulo manutenção.
Aviso Legal: Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.
Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.
Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Gerente suínocultura
description:

Garantir a produção eficiente, sustentável e de alta qualidade nas granjas (creches e engorda), por meio da gestão estratégica de pessoas, processos e recursos, assegurando o bem-estar animal, a sanidade do plantel e rentabilidade do negócio, em conformidade com as normas técnicas ambientais e de biossegurança. Dominar o manejo reprodutivo (cobertura, inseminação, diagnóstico de gestação), de crescimento, engorda e nutrição animal, sanidade e medicamentos.
Principais Responsabilidades Planejar e garantir a execução de todas as etapas: reprodução (cobertura, inseminação artificial, diagnóstico de gestação), controle de ciclo estral, taxas de fertilidade, parto e desmame, gestão de matrizes e leitões. Maternidade , creche e terminação (manejo nutricional por fase, conversão alimentar e ganho de peso, estratégias para redução de perdas, planejamento de abate). Monitorizar indicadores zootécnicos (taxa de parto, mortalidade, ganho de peso, conversão alimentar).
Garantir cumprimento das metas de produção e qualidade.
Implementar e garantir protocolos sanitários e de vacinação.
Controlar uso correto de medicamentos veterinários.
Prevenir surtos e agir rapidamente em casos de doença.
Assegurar cumprimentos de normas de biossegurança.
Liderar, treinar e desenvolver a equipe operacional.
Distribuir atividades e garantir disciplina operacional.
Acompanhar desempenho e engajamento.
Construir cultura de responsabilidade e cuidado.
Controlar custos (ração, medicamentos, mão de obra e insumos).
Otimizar uso de recursos e reduzir desperdícios.
Garantir rentabilidade da operação.
Reportar resultados a diretoria com indicadores.
Preparar granjas para auditorias e certificações.
Garantir bem-estar animal.
Atuar junto com fornecedores.

title: Coordenador de obras - incorporação
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador de obras - incorporação em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Oportunidade: Coordenador de Obras (Incorporação) Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Obras com perfil dinâmico e visão estratégica para integrar nosso time de Engenharia. Este profissional será o elo entre o planejamento da incorporadora e a execução técnica no canteiro, garantindo que nossos empreendimentos sejam entregues com excelência, dentro do prazo e do orçamento. Requisitos Fundamentais (Obrigatórios)
Experiência Comprovada: Vivência sólida na coordenação de múltiplas obras simultâneas no segmento de incorporação imobiliária (residencial ou comercial).
Formação: Graduação completa em Engenharia Civil com registro ativo no CREA.
Visão de Incorporação: Entendimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto imobiliário (do projeto à entrega das chaves/assistência técnica).
Responsabilidades e Atribuições Gestão Multiobras: Coordenar simultaneamente o andamento de diferentes canteiros, garantindo a padronização de processos e qualidade. Interface Estratégica: Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas de Projetos, Suprimentos e Financeiro da Incorporadora. Controle de Cronograma: Monitorar o caminho crítico das obras, antecipar riscos e propor planos de ação para desvios de prazo. Gestão de Custos: Acompanhar o fluxo de caixa das obras e o cumprimento do orçamento previsto (VGV/Custos diretos). Liderança de Equipes: Orientar os engenheiros residentes e equipes técnicas, promovendo um ambiente de alta performance e segurança. Qualidade e Normas: Garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas, PBQP-H e legislações municipais vigentes. Pré-requisitos Adicionais e Diferenciais Softwares de Gestão: Domínio de ferramentas de planejamento (MS Project ou Primavera) e ERPs de engenharia (Ex: Sienge , UAU ou Totvs). Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Lean Construction (Construção Enxuta) para otimização de processos. Gestão de Contratos: Habilidade na contratação e gestão de grandes empreiteiras e fornecedores críticos. Pós-Graduação: Especialização em Gestão de Projetos, Gestão de Negócios Imobiliários ou Engenharia de Custos será considerada um diferencial. Perfil Comportamental: Forte capacidade de negociação, resiliência para lidar com prazos desafiadores e excelente comunicação interpessoal.

title: Engenheiro de processos sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de processos sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. A Borborema Recursos Estratégicos é uma empresa brasileira que nasceu para transformar possibilidades em realidade. Desde 2021, atuamos na Bahia com foco em pesquisa mineral de terras raras, minerais essenciais para tecnologias modernas e para a transição energética. Nosso objetivo é unir inovação, responsabilidade e eficiência para construir um futuro sustentável. Somos subsidiárias da Brazilian Rare Earths e trabalhamos para posicionar o Brasil como protagonista no setor.
MISSÃO DO CARGO: Desenvolver estudos e análises complexas, relacionados às atividades no campo da engenharia de processos, respondendo por identificar e quantificar recursos minerais, desenvolvendo projetos de beneficiamento de minérios e metalurgia de terras raras e elementos estratégicos, por meio da realização de estudos técnicos e análises críticas de processos, para viabilizar a produção sustentável de minérios e compostos metálicos com abrangência em toda a operação da empresa, e garantir implementação de melhorias em processos e novas tecnologias.
RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO Suportar as atividades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de rotas de processo de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia aplicáveis ao processo de produção de elementos de terras raras e minerais estratégicos em escala de bancada, piloto e industrial, visando otimização e inovação.
Acompanhar a realização de testes metalúrgicos de beneficiamento mineral ou metalurgia em laboratórios internos, externos e Centros de Pesquisa, garantindo a qualidade dos processos e atendendo às demandas de P&D da empresa.
Revisar documentação de projetos de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia nas diversas fases (Scoping Study até Feasibility Study), apoiando na elaboração e revisão de fluxogramas de processo e engenharia, com o objetivo de assegurar a precisão técnica dos estudos.
Atuar de forma consultiva juntamente ao corpo técnico, direcionando na elaboração e execução de programas de testes metalúrgicos e na avaliação e consolidação de informações de processos, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional.
Elaborar e revisar relatórios e apresentações para suportar as decisões da Gerência de Processos e P&D, comunicando os resultados de forma clara e objetiva para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.
Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia, Engenharia de Minas e PMO nos estudos da disciplina de Processos para planta de beneficiamento mineral e hidrometalurgia, fornecendo suporte técnico e contribuindo para a resolução de problemas.
Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas e metas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, promovendo uma cultura organizacional de responsabilidade e prevenção.
Participar ativamente na formação e desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, disseminando conhecimentos e melhorando as competências do time em processos de beneficiamento mineral.
REQUISITOS DO CARGO Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia de Minas, Engenharia Química, Engenharia Metalúrgica e outras afins.
Idioma: Inglês Intermediário/Avançado
Disponibilidade para residir em Salvador/BA ou Lauro de Freitas/BA.
Disponibilidade para atuar eventualmente em regime de turno.
Competências Técnicas: Sólidos conhecimentos em processos metalúrgicos, beneficiamento mineral, elaboração de estudos de viabilidade, gerenciamento de projetos e domínio de softwares de modelagem de processos.
COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS Proatividade, orientação para resultados, habilidades de comunicação, trabalho em equipe, capacidade de análise crítica, resolução de problemas complexos, flexibilidade e espírito inovador.

title: Chiniese-brazilian portuguese interpreter & project coordinator（mandarin required））
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Chiniese-brazilian portuguese interpreter & project coordinator（mandarin required）） em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role:  We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Brazilian Portuguese Interpreter & Project Coordinator  to join our international team. This role serves as the critical bridge between our Chinese headquarters and our local operations in Brazil. It is a unique opportunity not only to utilize your language skills but also to grow into a project management or regional operations role.  Key Responsibilities:   Mandarin Interpretation & Translation:  Provide high-quality consecutive interpretation (Mandarin ↔ Brazilian Portuguese)  for board meetings, business negotiations, and technical site visits.  Document Management:  Translate project documents, contracts, and technical specifications from Chinese to Portuguese and vice versa  .  On-site Coordination:  Act as the primary linguistic link between Chinese expatriates and the local Brazilian workforce to ensure cultural alignment and operational efficiency.  Operational Support:  Assist HR, Finance, and Admin departments in interfacing with local entities using your bilingual skills.  Project Growth:  Take on project management tasks as your understanding of our Chinese-Brazilian operations deepens.   Qualifications (Mandarin is Essential):   Language Proficiency (Mandatory): Native or professional-level fluency in Mandarin Chinese (HSK 4 or equivalent)  and Brazilian Portuguese. (English is a plus)  Education:  Bachelor’s degree or higher.  Experience:  Proven experience in Chinese-Portuguese interpretation/translation. Candidates who have studied or worked in China are highly preferred.  Communication:  Exceptional cross-cultural communication skills and the ability to convey complex technical concepts between Chinese and Brazilian teams.  Mindset:  Strong sense of responsibility and willingness to work on-site (Expat/Stationed) with the Chinese team.   What We Offer (Benefits & Welfare):   Competitive Package:  Social Insurance &Accommodation provided + Overseas Allowance.  Home Leave:  1-2 times per year (Total 28 days), with round-trip international airfare fully covered by the company.  Holidays & Gifts:  Observance of Brazilian statutory holidays + Benefits for birthdays and traditional festivals (gifts, celebrations, etc.).  Accommodation:  Corporate housing provided.   Career Growth:  This is a developmental role with a clear career path. Top performers will have the opportunity to be promoted to core positions in Project Management  or Regional Operations  .

title: Artificial intelligence engineer

Bedrock
API Gateway
Managed AI/Cloud Services

Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.Preferred / Nice to Have

Hands-on experience with:

Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.)
Lang Chain / Llama Index

title: Technical recruiter (remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical recruiter (remote) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Reboot Monkey
Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents . We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide. We are a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet. Our clients range from hyperscalers and carriers to enterprises and startups who need reliable, fast datacenter operations — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
About the Role
Reboot Monkey operates 24 datacenter facilities across 6 continents. Every one of those facilities needs reliable, skilled Data Center Technicians (DCTs) who can execute Smart Hands and Remote Hands work to our standard. The quality of our DCT pool is the single biggest factor determining whether clients stay or leave.
As DCT Recruitment Specialist for the Asia-Pacific — covering India, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania , your job is to build and maintain a world-class DCT pool in your region. You are not a generic recruiter — you need to deeply understand what makes a great datacenter technician . You know the difference between someone who can rack a server properly and someone who will strip a screw on the first try. This role requires someone who has either worked as a DCT or managed DCTs directly . You must know the work inside and out — structured cabling, cross-connects, hardware installs, decommissions, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management. What You'll Do
Source, screen, and recruit Data Center Technicians across facilities in the APAC region
Conduct technical screening interviews — assess hands-on DC skills, not just resume keywords
Build and maintain a vetted DCT pool organized by location, skill level, availability, and reliability score
Verify technician credentials: certifications, references, and work history
Create and maintain DCT skill assessments and practical evaluation criteria
Coordinate onboarding of new DCTs: facility access, safety protocols, SOP training
Track DCT performance after deployment — build a feedback loop with the operations team
Continuously expand our DCT coverage to new markets and facilities in your region
Manage relationships with DCT staffing agencies where we use them
Maintain our DCT database with up-to-date availability, skills, and performance ratings
Requirements
3+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or team staffing experience (formal or informal — managing a DCT pool counts)
Ability to conduct technical interviews and assess hands-on datacenter skills
Knowledge of DC infrastructure: structured cabling, server racking, cross-connects, PDUs, environmental monitoring
Fluent written and spoken English
Organized and detail-oriented — managing a regional DCT database requires precision
Comfortable using spreadsheets, databases, or ATS tools to track candidates

title: Strategy consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategy consultant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Company Description
Marais Advisory is a boutique consulting firm specializing in AI implementation and competitive intelligence for enterprise clients. The firm emphasizes practical AI integration within existing infrastructure to drive strategic business transformation. With expertise in AWS, GCP, and Azure, Marais Advisory delivers end-to-end solutions covering enterprise AI roadmaps, evaluation frameworks, and multi-agent systems for competitive intelligence. The firm partners with organizations ranging from private equity to telecommunications, tailoring solutions like Service Now integrations and automated competitive intelligence systems. Marais Advisory prides itself on a results-driven approach, combining technical excellence and strategic insight to enable clients to seamlessly adapt in the AI era.

This is a full-time remote role for an Strategy Consultant. The Strategy Consultant will be responsible for advising clients on AI strategy, implementing data-driven solutions, and conducting research in fields like natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing complex datasets, designing AI roadmaps, creating evaluation frameworks, and leveraging pattern recognition techniques. The Consultant will also collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to ensure the practical deployment of AI solutions.
Qualifications
Proficiency in Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP)
Experience in Data Science and Pattern Recognition methodologies
Strong consulting skills with the ability to advise on AI strategies and business integration
Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, and programming skills in Python or related technologies
Effective communication and collaboration skills to interface with diverse stakeholders
Relevant professional experience in AI, data science, or enterprise technology consulting
A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field is preferred

Love helping people and solving problems fast? We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.

title: Senior mobile developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior mobile developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior Mobile Developer
Role Purpose
As a Mobile Developer Senior Developer you will be responsible for architecting and building high performance enterprise grade mobile applications within the Experience Engineering and Digital Emerging Tech portfolios. This role focuses on leveraging React Native and the Salesforce Mobile SDK to deliver offline first data rich applications for a global FMCG leader. You will integrate advanced capabilities like Open CV for image processing and manage complex local data using Smart Store, ensuring a seamless mobile experience within a hyper scaler heavy application landscape.
Key Responsibilities
Cross Platform Development: Design and develop robust mobile applications for i OS and Android using React Native
Salesforce Integration: Implement and customize mobile solutions using the Salesforce Mobile SDK ensuring seamless synchronization between mobile devices and Salesforce clouds
Offline Data Management: Architect Offline First capabilities using Smart Store DB, Salesforce Smart Store and Smart Sync to manage complex local data persistence and synchronization
Computer Vision Integration: Implement image processing and computer vision features, eg shelf scanning asset recognition or document processing using Open CV within the mobile environment
State Management: Manage complex application states and data flows using Redux or Redux Toolkit
Experience Engineering: Build highfidelity responsive UIs that provide superior user journeys for fieldforce users and consumers adhering to global brand standards
Version Control CI/CD: Manage source code branching strategies and pull requests using Git Hub integrated with automated mobile build pipelines
Emerging Tech Pilots: Support Digital Emerging Technology initiatives by prototyping mobile first AIML features and integrating with hyper scaler hosted APIs eg GCP Vision AI
Senior Developer Specifics: Lead technical design for mobile modules perform rigorous code reviews, optimize app performance, memory battery and mentor junior developers in mobile best practices
Primary Skills Must-Have
Core Framework: Expert level proficiency in React Native Java Script Type Script
Salesforce: Mobile Hands on experience with Salesforce Mobile SDK and Smart Store DB
State Management: Deep understanding of Redux for enterprisescale mobile apps
Computer Vision: Experience integrating Open CV or similar CNative modules into React Native applications
Version Control: Advanced proficiency in Git Hub workflows and Gitbased collaboration
Secondary Skills Good-to-Have
Native Modules: Ability to write Native Bridges in Swift Objective C i OS or Java Kotlin Android
Hyperscaler Exposure: Experience connecting mobile apps to GCPAzure backend services Cloud Run App Services
Salesforce Platform: Familiarity with Apex SOQL and Salesforce Lightning Web Components LWC
Mobile Security: Knowledge of OAuth2 Certificate Pinning and secure local storage patterns
FMCG Domain: Understanding of retail execution van sales or fieldforce automation workflows

title: Supervisor de Logística
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Supervisor de Logística em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DESCRIÇÃO

Oportunidade de Carreira em BOMIX
Junte-se à BOMIX e faça parte de uma equipe que valoriza a excelência e a inovação contínua.
Venha contribuir para o nosso sucesso!

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um profissional dedicado e experiente para se juntar à nossa equipe.
Supervisionar e otimizar as operações logísticas da empresa, assegurando eficiência nos processos de armazenagem, movimentação, transporte e distribuição de materiais e produtos, garantindo prazos, qualidade, redução de custos e nível de serviço ao cliente.

Principais Atividades

  • Apoiar o recebimento de todos os produtos para estoque, quantidade e qualidade dos mesmos, no intuito de certificar-se de que os produtos recebidos estão de acordo com o informado.
  • Verificar a correta armazenagem dos produtos no devido local, orientando quanto ao arranjo e ordenação dos itens, a fim de minimizar o desperdício de tempo na futura localização e distribuição dos mesmos.
  • Acompanhar o nível do estoque, analisando relatórios e avaliando requisições, no intuito de manter a liderança de Planejamento e Controle da Produção informada sobre a situação do mesmo.
  • Administrar problemas relacionados à entrega de produtos, desenvolvendo ações preventivas e corretivas, a fim de monitorar o cumprimento do planejado por parte da equipe.
  • Gerenciar a realização de inventário e vistorias periódicas, orientando a equipe quanto aos procedimentos necessários, a fim de possuir controle efetivo do almoxarifado de produtos.
  • Planejar e analisar periodicamente os itens em estoque, checar as condições de armazenamento, obsolescência, entre outros, visando à redução de perdas.
  • Coordenar os processos e realizar o planejamento das atividades na área.
  • Realizar a coordenação direta de equipe de colaboradores do setor logístico.
  • Implementar e acompanhar indicadores de performance da área.
  • Fazer diagnóstico dos processos da área e propor melhorias.
  • Administrar o inventário da área.
  • Administrar o processo de Devolução de mercadorias.
  • Administrar o processo de divergências, abertura de reclamações via RNC – Relatório de Não Conformidades.
  • Realizar acompanhamento diário do recebimento de insumo e material, avaliando-os e respectivas documentações.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Desejável graduação em Administração de empresas, logística e afins.

Informações Adicionais

Local de trabalho: Simões Filho
Regime de contratação: CLT
Salário: Compatível com o mercado
Horário: 2x2

  • Local de trabalho: Salvador, BA
  • Regime de contratação de tipo: Efetivo – CLT

title: Almoxarife I
description:

  • Atender às reservas e requisições de materiais, separando e entregando conforme necessidade das áreas internas.

  • Realizar contagens cíclicas e apoiar na execução de inventários físicos.

  • Apoiar na organização e limpeza do almoxarifado, conforme padrões de 5S.
  • Lançar movimentações básicas no sistema ERP, com apoio ou sob orientação do Almoxarife II ou do líder.
  • Comunicar divergências ou anomalias nos materiais ou processos ao superior imediato.
  • Apoiar em outras atividades do setor sempre que necessário.
  • Realizar descargas, e movimentações dentro do almoxarifado com o uso de empilhadeira.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio Completo.
  • Habilitação em Empilhadeira (NR 11).
  • Carteira de Habilitação B.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Experiência atuando em almoxarifado.
  • Vivência no pacote office, principalmente Excel;
  • Conhecimento em procedimentos de recebimento, conferência e controle de estoque, em sistema ERP (movimentações, baixas, requisições) e em inventário físico e contagem cíclica.

Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.

Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.

Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Analista De Processos Pleno | Simões Filho, Ba
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Processos Pleno | Simões Filho, Ba em simões filho. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Missão

O(a) profissional será responsável por padronizar processos, impulsionar melhorias, desenvolver e realizar treinamentos, monitorar KPIs para

Experiência em mapeamento de processos, melhoria contínua (Kaizen, Lean, Six Sigma) e padronização;

title: Talent Data Analyst - Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Data Analyst - Remote em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.

Key responsibilities:

- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Data Analysis tools, developing reports according to analyst-defined specifications.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.

Requirements:

- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- An understanding of top-of-the-line Data Analysis tools. Previous experience with administration, licensing, security, and deployment is a plus.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.

Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.
